Nimbly stepping from stone to stone along the surf, the receding sea reveals tidal pool locked fi sh for the vinnirex to quickly snatch 
what prey they can in the crowded coasts. Rising from subterranean rivers, sharp barks echo off darkened chambers as the canines 
drag a skith out into the sunlight. Packs of vinnirex run along side bloomux, harrying the rotund insects for their delicious honey. Th ese 
far ranging canines have found their way all across the island, perfectly adapted to a wide range of environments, using their webbed 
paws to tread the ocean, and their thick coarse fur to survive the colder altitudes. Hunting in tight familial packs, communicating and 
executing strategic maneuvers, these canines can effectively surround and take down larger prey than one would expect.
Class - Mammalia • Genus Derived Evolution - Canis • Niche - Generalist Scavenger Omnivore

Encountering Packs of these canines are commonly seen 
scavenging or harrying prey all over the island. In their tight 
familial units they tend to be very aggressive towards strangers. 
If found alone however, their instinctual need to be part of a 
group softens their resolve, and through patient interactions 
and offerings of food, a single vinnirex could be coerced into a 
sort of pack kinship with a Traveler.
Cunning Bark (1/Day) A single ally of the vinnirex can add 1d4 
to one attack roll, ability check, or Saving Th row it makes for 1 
minute. Allied creatures can only have one Strategic Bark bonus 
at a time.
